# Sync component

> Reads a company's sources at the company, plans with brain-runner what changes in the Brain and applies it on a person's command, or on its own where a person switched that on and the plan holds nothing a person must decide, and answers the Brain's fetch and write jobs for GitHub sources.

## Identity

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `L3-SYNC-COMPONENT` |
| Kind | code |
| Owner | `ROLE-ENGINE-OWNER` |
| Level | 3 |
| Parent | `L2-CONNECTION` |

### Source paths

- `KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/src/sync_component`
- `KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/Dockerfile`
- `KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/requirements.txt`

## Purpose

### Responsible for

| Id | Statement | Code |
|---|---|---|
| `L3-SYNC-COMPONENT/R-1` | Reading a source of the kinds it knows (http_json, github, a mounted share) with the source's own credential from its environment. | `KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/src/sync_component/fetchers.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/src/sync_component/share.py` |
| `L3-SYNC-COMPONENT/R-2` | Dry runs and applies through brain-runner, an apply writing exactly the plan the last dry run made; diff polling of GitHub sources (only the mappings new commits concern are planned), the sync state per source, and the automatic apply of clean scheduled plans where a person switched it on (KG-2). | `KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/src/sync_component/agent.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/src/sync_component/engine.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/src/sync_component/runner_cli.py` |
| `L3-SYNC-COMPONENT/R-3` | In link mode, talking to Knovas Link only; in direct mode, enrolling with the Platform itself (connector protocol v1). | `KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/src/sync_component/__main__.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/src/sync_component/link_client.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/src/sync_component/client.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/src/sync_component/identity.py` |
| `L3-SYNC-COMPONENT/R-4` | The jobs of the work channel - probe, fetch (a GitHub original) and write (a GitHub pull request that changes front-matter values only). | `KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/src/sync_component/jobs.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/src/sync_component/github_jobs.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/src/sync_component/front_matter_edit.py` |
| `L3-SYNC-COMPONENT/R-5` | Connector protocol 2.0 (draft, SYNC_PROTOCOL_V2, off by default) - the GitHub connector on the connector kit - its declaration (one action set_front_matter, staging direct and native_review, no inverse) and the jobs preview, act, reread and review_outcome; direct writes one commit with the expected blob sha and the permit id. | `KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/src/sync_component/github_v2.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/src/sync_component/jobs.py` |

### Not responsible for

- Transferring documents (the Knovas Connector does); it moves records through the mapping runner.
- Fetch and write for sources other than GitHub; writing to YAML or JSON files or below the front matter's top level.
- Renewing its certificate in direct mode; «Token erneuern» in the Platform enrols it again.

### Terms

- link mode (behind Knovas Link, turned on by SYNC_LINK_URL)
- direct mode (enrolled with the Platform itself)
- acknowledged stream (the stream state the last successful apply left, the next plan's previous)
- synced commit (the commit the last apply without errors synced, per source, in sync-state.json)
- automatic apply (a person's switch per source; only a plan with nothing a person must decide, engine.attention)

| `L3-SYNC-COMPONENT/job.write/N-1` | The job's mode is proposal (else refused mode_unsupported), the source is switched to read_write (else refused), and its credential may write contents and pull requests (else refused token_cannot_write). | critical | kind: test, ref: `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_github_write.py`, checks: `TestNothingIsWritten::test_a_mode_other_than_proposal_is_refused`; `TestNothingIsWritten::test_a_source_switched_to_read_is_refused`; `TestNothingIsWritten::test_a_token_that_cannot_write_is_refused` |

#### Promises

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `L3-SYNC-COMPONENT/job.write/P-1` | brain-runner's compile-write turns the job into the change of one file, and its refusal is the job's; the file read at the branch head must have the blob sha expected_version, else conflict and nothing is written. | critical | kind: test, ref: `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_github_write.py`, checks: `TestNothingIsWritten::test_what_the_inverse_mapping_refuses_is_the_jobs_refusal`; `TestNothingIsWritten::test_a_file_changed_since_the_version_is_a_conflict` |
| `L3-SYNC-COMPONENT/job.write/P-2` | Only the changed values' text in the front matter is replaced - body, key order, comments, line endings and BOM stay byte-identical; a front matter it cannot change safely is refused edit_unsupported or front_matter_missing, the same values no_change. | critical | kind: test, ref: `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_github_write.py`, checks: `TestAProposalBecomesAPullRequest::test_the_pull_request_carries_only_the_changed_values`; `TestNothingIsWritten::test_a_front_matter_the_editor_cannot_change_safely_is_refused`; `TestNothingIsWritten::test_the_same_values_change_nothing`; kind: test, ref: `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_front_matter_edit.py` |
| `L3-SYNC-COMPONENT/job.write/P-3` | The change is committed on a new branch knovas/write-JOBID, never on the source's branch, with a message naming the declared agent and 12 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the declared person; a pull request is opened and its URL is the result's source_ref; a job claimed again answers the same pull request. | critical | kind: test, ref: `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_github_write.py`, checks: `TestAProposalBecomesAPullRequest::test_the_commit_names_the_agent_and_only_a_hash_of_the_person`; `TestAProposalBecomesAPullRequest::test_a_job_claimed_again_ends_with_the_same_pull_request`; `TestAProposalBecomesAPullRequest::test_without_a_ref_the_default_branch_takes_the_pull_request` |
| `L3-SYNC-COMPONENT/job.write/P-4` | A step that fails after the branch was made deletes the branch again (else the code is github.branch_left); a branch someone else changed is never deleted. | standard | kind: test, ref: `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_github_write.py`, checks: `TestABranchLeftBehindIsCleanedUp::test_a_failed_step_after_the_branch_deletes_the_branch`; `TestABranchLeftBehindIsCleanedUp::test_a_branch_that_cannot_be_deleted_is_named_in_the_code`; `TestABranchLeftBehindIsCleanedUp::test_a_branch_someone_else_changed_is_never_deleted` |

#### Needs

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `L3-SYNC-COMPONENT/job.v2/N-1` | SYNC_PROTOCOL_V2 is on and Knovas Link speaks protocol 2.0; an act carries the permits Link checked, each bound to its own step (else refused permit_mismatch), and the source is switched to read_write (else refused write_disabled). | critical | kind: test, ref: `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_sync_component_github_v2.py`, checks: `test_the_github_connector_passes_the_conformance_suite`; `test_a_source_that_only_reads_is_never_written` |

#### Promises

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `L3-SYNC-COMPONENT/job.v2/P-1` | A preview reads the file at the branch head, writes nothing, and shows before and after per front matter key with a diff and the blob sha it read, each change naming its step (two steps on one file are told apart, D-14); a computed fact makes it inexact. | critical | kind: test, ref: `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_sync_component_github_v2.py`, checks: `test_the_github_connector_passes_the_conformance_suite`; `test_a_direct_write_is_one_commit_on_the_branch_with_the_permit_and_no_pull_request`; `test_two_steps_on_one_file_are_told_apart_by_their_step` |
| `L3-SYNC-COMPONENT/job.v2/P-2` | A direct act is one commit on the source's branch through the contents API with the expected blob sha and the trailer Knovas-Permit - a changed file is conflict version_changed and nothing is written, a repeat finds its commit and answers its receipt without writing again, and the receipt comes from reading the file again; its values, differences and a conflict name step 0 (one file per act). No pull request. | critical | kind: test, ref: `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_sync_component_github_v2.py`, checks: `test_a_direct_write_is_one_commit_on_the_branch_with_the_permit_and_no_pull_request`; `test_a_file_changed_after_the_preview_is_a_conflict_and_nothing_is_written`; `test_the_github_connector_passes_the_conformance_suite`; `test_two_steps_on_one_file_are_told_apart_by_their_step` |
| `L3-SYNC-COMPONENT/job.v2/P-3` | A native_review act opens today's pull request on knovas/write-&lt;permit id>; review_outcome answers pending, accepted with receipts once merged, or declined once closed. unstage is not offered in V1. | standard | kind: test, ref: `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_sync_component_github_v2.py`, checks: `test_native_review_opens_a_pull_request_and_follows_its_outcome`; `test_unstage_is_not_offered_in_v1` |

#### Limits

| Id | Statement | Risk class |
|---|---|---|
| `L3-SYNC-COMPONENT/job.v2/L-1` | One file per step (grouping none); reading stays protocol 1.x's (no stream declared); no inverse. | standard |

## Decisions and risks

### Decisions

| Id | Statement |
|---|---|
| `DEC-0040` | The mapping runner is the component's engine; plan on a dry run, apply exactly the plan a dry run made. |

### Risks

| Id | Statement | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| `L3-SYNC-COMPONENT/RISK-01` | Link mode needs a brain-runner release that takes BRAIN_LOCAL_TOKEN and compile-write, and diff polling one with affected --source github (0.3.2 or later); with 0.3.1 every new commit plans every mapping, and an image with an older pin cannot plan, apply or answer write jobs behind Link (README, "Release coupling"). | The image, the Platform's image and CI pin the same release (BRAIN_RUNNER_GIT_REF, CI's BRAIN_RUNNER_SHA); both images' builds stop on another version (BRAIN_RUNNER_VERSION); a release run prints the version its image carries. |
